hypotheses.RS1_rank1_assignment: At rank 1, the fixed-norm diagonal assignment is globally best with exact p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.RS2_rank1_row_wins: At rank 1, the own category is the row maximum for at least four eligible targets on every corpus.
hypotheses.RS3_rank1_improves_rank4: Rank 1 has a smaller or equal assignment p-value than rank 4 on every corpus.
hypotheses.RS4_random_positive_rank1: Rank-1 diagonal assignment remains significant on random-positive contexts on every corpus.
hypotheses.RS5_natural_rank1: Unscaled rank-1 projection ablation has a significant diagonal assignment on every corpus.
